instruction: A clean, bright lifestyle photograph with a medium shot of a minimalist white dance studio. On the right foreground, the young woman in the beige sports bra (R4) stands with her arms raised forward and up, looking forward-left. In the background on the left, the blonde girl in the beige long-sleeve crop top (R5) stands straight with her arms down, looking in the same direction. They are practicing synchronized dance movements. Soft natural light fills the room from large windows, creating a neutral beige and white color palette.
